name: homie
description: Build games and apps with Homie’s engine packages, animated characters, sound, music and video skills. Play from a post on X. Publish on your own Cloudflare and connect your own Stripe with one approval. Open source.

paneAutoOpen.title: Open the Studio pane when a build starts
paneAutoOpen.description: The Studio pane (and the parts pane, when agents build in parallel) opens by itself when a build starts, where the terminal is wide enough for a pane nobody asked for (144 columns; 110 once you have opened it). /studio always opens it.

band.title: The studio band above the prompt
band.description: One line above the prompt inside a studio: the studio, the game, the build's step and %, a Play link and how many people are playing now. Nothing outside a studio.

guardFiles.title: Hold edits to protected files
guardFiles.description: An edit to a file that studio.json "protect" lists waits for your Proceed, with its diff.

guardDeploys.title: Hold production deploys
guardDeploys.description: A deploy (homie-studio deploy, npm run deploy, wrangler deploy, studio_deploy, a media publish) waits for your Proceed, with what will change; so does a change to the studio's Cloudflare account outside its deploy (a delete, a secret, a hand rollout, a write to the live database, by Wrangler or Cloudflare's MCP).

guardSpend.title: Hold paid media calls past the budget
guardSpend.description: A fal, ElevenLabs or Tripo call that would pass studio.json "budget", the build's budget or the job's cap (or whose cost cannot be read first: a provider's own CLI, MCP server or API) waits for your Proceed, with its estimated cost; so does downloading a Clef model through Ollama (ollama pull clef-flash, about 11 GB), with its size.

redactSecrets.title: Take secrets out of tool output
redactSecrets.description: Keys and tokens (Cloudflare, fal, ElevenLabs, GitHub and others, office keys, hap_ agent passes) are hidden from Claude in every tool result; one-time owner links go to the Studio pane instead.

renderResults.title: Draw Homie's results natively
renderResults.description: Setup status as a checklist, checks as rows, playtest verdicts, deploys with their live links, and Homie's commands named in words.

arcade.title: The arcade
arcade.description: /arcade plays a live Homie game in a pane (a headless Chrome seat on this computer, paused while the pane is hidden).

pictures.title: Pictures in the terminal
pictures.description: "blocks" draws game frames as coloured character cells (every truecolor terminal); "image" draws real pixels where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm).
